# Mold Busters

> > Premium environmental solutions and certified mold remediation services across Ontario and Quebec with IICRC-certified experts, same-day inspections, and price-match guarantees.

Mold Busters is a leading mold remediation and environmental solutions company operating across Ontario and Quebec with multiple service locations. The company specializes in certified mold inspection, testing, removal, and air quality services, backed by IICRC certification and 15+ years of industry experience.
